title: Perfect constant models for stratified finite-field etale complexes
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and let $k$ be a finite field. Let $L\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},k)$ be a bounded complex in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of sheaves of modules over the constant sheaf $k_X$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose every cohomology sheaf is constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. There is a finite stratification of $X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-constructible-subset] such that on an etale covering of each stratum $S$, $L|_S$ is isomorphic to the constant sheaf complex of a bounded complex of finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces; in particular the constant complex is perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. After pro-etale comparison these are also the models of $(\nu_X^*L)|_S$, using [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. No integral lifting or completeness hypothesis is involved.

source.place: Proposition 6.6.11, forward implication, residue stratification; Proposition 6.8.11(3)
